info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Event Test Subscription API
info.description: The Webhook Event Test Subscription API allows developers to validate and test the configuration of event subscriptions for specific webhooks. By specifying the unique identifiers for the webhook and the event, users can initiate test subscriptions that ensure the proper handling and delivery of event information. This endpoint is particularly useful for developers integrating with webhook services, enabling them to confirm that their applications respond correctly to various events. Typical consumers of this API include developers and system integrators aiming to streamline their integration processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the test subscriptions associated with the specified webhook. It is useful for developers to verify the setup of webhook notifications without impacting production data.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves test subscriptions for the specified webhook event. It is designed to validate configurations and ensure that callbacks are functioning as intended.

GetTestSubscriptionsForWebhookRes100045R.title: Webhook Test Subscription Request Body
GetTestSubscriptionsForWebhookRes100045R.description: The JSON request body structure used for testing webhook subscriptions. This schema defines the expected format of the payload when performing a GET operation to validate or test subscriptions.
